materials.name: α-Polonium
materials.atomic_mass_note: Po has no standard atomic weight. This Po-209 isotope mass is a representative value for the model density; the cited crystal study used a Po-208/Po-209 mixture.
materials.phase_note: α-Po is the low-temperature simple-cubic phase; β-Po is rhombohedral.
materials.conditions: DeSando and Lange's X-ray study used a Po-208/Po-209 isotope mixture in helium; a = 3.359 ± 0.001 Å. A measurement temperature was not specified in the accessible abstract.

sources.name: DeSando and Lange (1966)
sources.reference: R. DeSando and R. Lange, Journal of Inorganic and Nuclear Chemistry 28, 1837–1846 (1966), doi:10.1016/0022-1902(66)80270-1.

sources.name: AFLOW Encyclopedia of Crystallographic Prototypes
sources.reference: α-Po simple-cubic prototype A_cP1_221_a-001, space group Pm-3m (No. 221).

sources.name: NIST Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions
CIAAW Standard Atomic Weights
sources.reference: CIAAW lists no standard atomic weight for polonium.

materials.name: α-Iron (ferrite)
materials.conditions: AIST tabulates a = 2.8665(1) Å at 25 °C, citing von Batchelder and Raeuchle (1954).

sources.name: AIST Crystal Structure Gallery
sources.reference: F. W. von Batchelder and R. F. Raeuchle, Acta Crystallographica 7, 464 (1954); AIST entry at 25 °C.

materials.name: Copper
materials.conditions: AIST tabulates a = 3.6148 Å at 18 °C, citing Rothery and Andrews (1942).

sources.name: AIST Crystal Structure Gallery
sources.reference: AIST crystal-structure record at 18 °C, citing work by Rothery and Andrews (1942); the original lattice unit was converted to ångströms by AIST.

sources.name: CIAAW Abridged Standard Atomic Weights
sources.reference: Cu abridged standard atomic weight 63.546 ± 0.003 (2024 table).

materials.name: Magnesium
materials.phase_note: Ambient-pressure hexagonal-close-packed magnesium; the measured c/a differs from the ideal HCP ratio.
materials.conditions: AIST tabulates a = 3.2094(2) Å and c = 5.2105(4) Å at 25 °C, citing Straumanis (1949). The c/a field is derived from those two values.

sources.name: AIST Crystal Structure Gallery
sources.reference: M. E. Straumanis, Journal of Applied Physics 20, 726 (1949); AIST entry at 25 °C.

sources.name: CIAAW Abridged Standard Atomic Weights
sources.reference: Mg abridged standard atomic weight 24.305 ± 0.002 (2024 table).
